components.name: Alert
components.description: Persistent inline message. Type = Info | Success | Warning | Danger x Variant = Inline | Banner, 8 variants. WHY TWO VARIANTS ONLY: Inline sits inside a form or card (radius/md, bordered on all four edges, FILL width of its column); Banner spans the viewport (radius/none, hairline on top and bottom only, X padding = the page gutter) for site-wide notices and the checkout error summary. Hover/pressed/focus/disabled are NOT axes: the alert itself is never interactive; its Dismiss (IconButton) and action Buttons own their own states. WHY A TINTED FILL (lead decision, overrides spec 24.4): foundations 01 ships color/bg/{info,success,warning,danger}-subtle expressly for alerts, so the fill is the per-Type subtle tint with a hairline color/feedback/* border and a 20px color/feedback/* FILLED Phosphor icon; text stays neutral (color/text/primary title, color/text/secondary body) so contrast never depends on the tint. Meaning travels on four channels - icon SHAPE (info circle-i / check-circle / warning triangle / warning-circle), icon colour, border colour and the title's words - so greyscale and Windows High Contrast still distinguish the types (WCAG 1.4.1). WHY radius/md and not radius/lg: an alert, above all a Danger alert in a form, is a credibility surface; the playful radii belong to product cards (same reasoning as Tooltip). WHAT IT MUST NEVER DO: never auto-dismiss (a self-dismissing message is a Toast); never collapse its height on dismiss (fade 120ms, then the space is reclaimed instantly, so the form does not move under the user's finger); never carry an illustration, emoji, mascot or exclamation mark; never say 'Oops' or 'Something went wrong' without naming the fix; never pin itself - it sits immediately above the element it concerns inside the same scroll container. The title names the failure, the body names the fix. On a multi-field failure the body holds real <a href=#field> links, one per invalid field, and activating one calls .focus() on the input. A11Y: role=status + aria-live=polite for Info/Success; role=alert for Warning/Danger; the role lives on a container that already exists in the DOM so the announcement fires. Icon is aria-hidden. A Danger alert raised by a failed submit takes programmatic focus (tabindex=-1 + .focus()); Info/Success never steal focus. Dismissing returns focus to the element that preceded the alert, never <body>. BANGLA (0.7): strategy WRAP - title up to 2 lines, body unbounded; the root is FILL x HUG so the form absorbs the growth (Danger example: 136px en -> ~208px bn, +53%). Icon column (20) and dismiss column (44) never change width. Title cap 48 Bangla characters, body cap 200. TOUCH (0.8): Dismiss is IconButton Medium = 44x44 natively; actions are Button Size=Medium (44) because the default content is storefront checkout and Button Small is forbidden on storefront mobile (1.8); admin instances swap the nested Buttons to Size=Small, which carry their own _hit44. Dismiss sits space/3 from the text so its hit area never overlaps an in-body link.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Ephemeral floating confirmation. Type = Info | Success | Warning | Danger x HasAction = False | True, 8 variants. HasAction IS an axis (not a boolean) because the Action layer's presence changes the row's geometry and the mobile dismiss rule; Type is an axis because the icon glyph differs per type and per-variant content may not be a bound property (binding decision 3). WHY a NEUTRAL surface (color/bg/surface-raised + hairline color/border/default + Elevation e3) with only the 20px FILLED Phosphor icon coloured: a toast is small and lives four seconds; a coloured fill would be the loudest thing on screen. Same reasoning as Alert, where the tint is justified by persistence. WHY FIXED 360: the desktop geometry; on mobile the instance is FILL inside the 16px gutters (358 at 390px) - a 2px difference, one master. WHAT IT IS FOR: 'Added to cart' + 'View cart' (Success, 6000ms) is the primary use; 'Removed from cart' + 'Undo' (Info, 6000ms) is the only destructive-adjacent toast and the data-layer undo window outlives the toast. WHAT IT MUST NEVER DO: never carry a form validation error (Input inline error + Alert Danger instead); never carry a blocking failure (Alert Danger, persistent); never ask a decision (Modal); never show progress over 10s (ProgressBar); never hold more than one action and never a destructive one; the body is never a tap target (a whole-toast tap next to a dismiss is a mis-tap generator). Type=Danger never auto-dismisses. TIMING: Success/Info 4000ms, 6000ms with an action; Warning 6000ms; Danger manual only. Timer PAUSES on hover, on focus-within and while document.hidden; it resumes, never restarts (WCAG 2.2.1). STACKING: max 3 visible, a fourth queues; mobile bottom-centre, 72px above the MobileNav (136 when the sticky AddToCartBar is present), newest nearest the thumb, gap space/2; desktop top-right at 24/24, newest at the top. z-index above MobileNav, AddToCartBar and WhatsAppFab, below Modal/Drawer only. Never covers the Add to cart button. A11Y: two live regions exist from first paint and are never unmounted - <output aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true> for Info/Success and <div role=alert> for Warning/Danger; a region created at toast time does not announce. Focus is NEVER moved to a toast; its Action and Dismiss ARE tabbable while visible and the timer pauses on focus so a keyboard user can reach them; after activation focus returns where it was. Esc dismisses the newest toast only when focus is inside the region. Icon aria-hidden. Cart-count changes are announced by the cart badge's own live region, not the toast. BANGLA (0.7): WRAP - message 2 lines max, detail 1 line; when the message wraps to 2 lines the detail is not rendered; when both an action and a dismiss would be present on MOBILE the dismiss is dropped (swipe + timer cover it) to reclaim 56px of text width - desktop keeps both. Message cap 56 Bangla characters, detail cap 32. Numerals are Western (0-9) in both locales. TOUCH (0.8): Action is Button Ghost Small (36) with its own _hit44 - the documented exception to the storefront ban on Small, because Medium + dismiss + two Bangla lines does not fit 358px and nothing competes within 12px. Dismiss is IconButton Medium, 44x44 natively. The whole 358 x >=56 toast is the swipe grab area on touch.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description:
Static zero-content composition. One axis, Type = NoResults | EmptyCart | EmptyWishlist | NoOrders | Error404 | Error500, 6 variants. Type drives the default glyph, copy and action set - so title, body, button labels, glyph and the presence of a Secondary action are PER-VARIANT CONTENT and are deliberately NOT bound to properties (binding decision 3: one default per set would print 'No toys match those filters' on the empty cart). Designers edit the text layers and nested Button labels directly on an instance. WHY no Size axis: the component is FILL width with Content capped at max-width 420 at every breakpoint; the illustration's 160/200 size and the actions' vertical/horizontal switch are media queries (<480px stacks FILL Large buttons, >=480px a HUG horizontal row of Medium). The master is the MOBILE presentation at 390 because that is where every storefront empty state is mostly seen. ILLUSTRATION: no illustrations exist yet (content spec 05 Part C defines eleven, none drawn). The `Illustration` layer is a 160x160 FRAME placeholder filled color/bg/brand-subtle with radius/lg holding a 48px (size/icon-category) FILLED Phosphor glyph in color/bg/brand - a stand-in for the two-tone brand+accent drawing on a brand-subtle ground. It is decorative: alt='' aria-hidden, explicit width/height so it reserves space and adds no CLS. WHY Error500 HAS NO ILLUSTRATION LAYER AT ALL: illustration is permitted in exactly the content-spec list (empty states, 404, no-results, order-success); a server error is a failure the business owns and a cheerful drawing beside it reads as not taking it seriously - the same rule that bans illustration from form errors. Its body gives a phone number because a parent whose checkout just failed needs a person, not a picture. The number is a PLACEHOLDER (01XXX-XXXXXX) until the owner supplies the shop line; it is never guessed. COPY RULES: no baby-talk, no exclamation marks, no 'Oops', no 'Yay'. 'Your cart is empty', never 'Your cart is feeling lonely!'. Zero results never ends the journey: NoResults carries the FILL-width `Extra` slot for the Tier 2 EmptyState/Suggestions composite (correction line, 4 closest-category Chips, a Best sellers rail). A11Y: the title is a real heading at the page's outline level (h2 inside a listing that already has an h1; h1 on 404/500 where it IS the page heading) - never a styled

. The component is NOT a live region; a NoResults state replacing a grid is announced by the listing's existing aria-live=polite region, and focus stays on the filter control the user just used. Navigation actions are (Shop by age, Go to home), state-changing actions are

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Alert/Title
newTextStyles.why: Spec 24.3 sets the alert title at en/body 15 / 1.6 / 700. Latin/Mobile/body is 15/400 and Latin/Mobile/body-strong (created by manifest 02) is 15/600; nothing is 15/700. The 700 is deliberate: the alert title must out-weigh the Toast message (600) and the body copy around it in a form, because it is the one line that names the failure. Line-height 160% so a two-line Bangla title keeps the body rhythm.

newTextStyles.name: Bangla/Alert/Title
newTextStyles.usedBy: Alert › TextBlock/Title on the Bangla documentation instances and the .lang-bn build
newTextStyles.why: Bangla parallel of Latin/Alert/Title: 1.60 x 1.15 = 1.84 per foundations 5.2; all Bangla tracking is 0.

notes: CONVENTION / bindTo arrays, gradients, omitted keys: as in manifests 04 and 05. A STRING on gap/padding/strokeWeight/cornerRadiusToken/fillToken/strokeToken/effectStyle/textStyle is a Figma variable or style name to BIND, never a typed number; a NUMBER is a raw px value and each one is justified in a note below. fillToken: null / strokeToken: null / effectStyle: null means remove that paint or effect. Later children paint on top. absolute.inset is {t,r,b,l}; a missing edge is unconstrained.

CONVENTION / strokeSides (new key): the layer vocabulary has no per-edge stroke field. `strokeSides` lists which of TOP/RIGHT/BOTTOM/LEFT carry the stroke; set strokeTopWeight/strokeRightWeight/strokeBottomWeight/strokeLeftWeight to the bound strokeWeight for listed edges and 0 for the others. Used on Alert Variant=Banner (TOP + BOTTOM only, 24.3) and on the MobileNav placeholder in the mobile Toast region frame (TOP only). Everywhere else all four edges are stroked and the key is informational.

CONVENTION / sizeToken on ICON_INSTANCE: `sizeToken` names the size variable to bind the instance's width and height to (size/icon-md = 20 for every Alert and Toast icon; size/icon-category = 48 for the EmptyState placeholder glyph). The numeric `size` is the rendered value for placement.

CONVENTION / exposedNestedInstances (new key): Figma cannot bind a parent TEXT property to a nested instance's text property - it can only EXPOSE the nested instance's properties (component.exposedInstances / 'Expose properties from nested instances'). The listed layers are exposed, so `label`, `ariaLabel`, `Size` etc. of the nested Button/IconButton appear in the parent instance's panel. This replaces the spec's dismissAriaLabel (24.2, 25.2), actionLabel (25.2), primaryLabel/secondaryLabel (29.2) TEXT properties - same designer outcome, honest to the Figma model. `nestedOverrides` in documentationInstances are values set on those exposed properties (variantProps such as Size included).

CONVENTION / layerTextOverrides in documentationInstances: direct character edits on text layers that NO property owns (EmptyState title/body). Legal on an instance precisely because the layer is unbound.

CONVENTION / FILL on a variant root: Alert and EmptyState roots are specified `sizing.h: FILL` (the production behaviour). Inside a component set a variant has no auto-layout parent, so the lead builds the master at the stated `size.w` (358 Inline / 390 Banner / 390 EmptyState) and sets layoutSizingHorizontal = FILL on instances placed in auto-layout parents - same handling as Select (manifest 02) and Switch (04). Toast is genuinely FIXED 360 (desktop geometry) and becomes FILL only on mobile instances.

CONFLICT / Alert fill: spec 24.4 binds every Alert to color/bg/surface and argues 'the semantic palette has no bg/feedback/*-subtle tokens'. That is stale - foundations 01 §(colour) ships color/bg/info-subtle, success-subtle, warning-subtle and danger-subtle with the explicit note 'Alerts cannot be built from feedback/* alone', and the lead's brief directs the per-Type subtle tint. Built as: fill color/bg/{type}-subtle, hairline color/feedback/{type} border, color/feedback/{type} icon, color/text/primary title, color/text/secondary body. Spec 24.4's four reasons for a neutral surface stay true in spirit: text is still neutral so no per-type text-contrast check is needed. CONTRAST CHECK FOR THE LEAD: the 20px icon is a non-text graphic needing 3:1 against the TINT, not against white; verify color/feedback/warning on color/bg/warning-subtle in Light mode (24.4 measured 3.1:1 against white, so the tint will push it under 3:1). If it fails, the icon's meaning is still carried by shape + border + title (four channels), and the fix is a darker warning/700 primitive on the icon layer only, recorded then.

CONFLICT / Alert axis naming: the lead's brief calls the axis 'Tone'; spec 24.1 and 25.1 name it `Type`, matching Badge's existing `Type` axis and the React prop. Built as `Type`. Rename is a one-line change on both sets if the lead prefers Tone (Spinner's precedent).

CONFLICT / Alert per-Type iconSwap (24.2) and Toast iconSwap (25.2) are DROPPED as properties: the glyph differs per Type, so it is per-variant content (binding decision 3). Lucide -> Phosphor: info -> icon/info, check-circle -> icon/check-circle, alert-triangle -> icon/warning (NEW, triangle - listed in newIcons; it must differ in SHAPE from Danger per 24.9), alert-circle -> icon/warning-circle. Phosphor glyphs are FILLED: colour with the fill, never a stroke; the spec's 'stroke 2px' is void.

CONFLICT / Alert actionsSlot INSTANCE_SWAP with default `Alert/Actions` (24.2): no such component exists and none may be invented. Replaced by an in-tree `TextBlock/Actions` frame holding two nested Button instances (Primary Outline + Secondary Ghost) with showActions / showSecondaryAction booleans and exposed nested labels. Nothing is lost: 24.3 already dictates exactly these two buttons.

CONFLICT / (spec-internal) Alert action Button size: 24.3 says Button Size=Small; 24.8 says Small is forbidden on storefront mobile and 'storefront alert actions use Size=Medium'; the set's default copy is the storefront checkout decline. Built with Size=Medium (44 tall) so the default never violates 1.8; admin instances swap the exposed nested Size to Small (documentation instance 'Admin inline'). Button Small carries its own _hit44, so no extra hit layer is needed anywhere on Alert.

ALERT / auto-layout and alignment: root HORIZONTAL, primary MIN, counter MIN (TOP - the dismiss must not float to the middle of a four-line Bangla alert), gap space/3, Min height 56 (frame minHeight, not a fixed height), Clip content FALSE. IconWrapper VERTICAL FIXED 20 x HUG, padding-top 2 (RAW px - see DERIVE). TextBlock VERTICAL FILL x HUG gap space/1, children Title -> Body -> Actions. Actions HORIZONTAL HUG x HUG, gap space/2, padding-top space/3 (the spec's '12 above actions' is this padding INSIDE the space/1 gap, giving 16 total, exactly as 24.6 draws it). Dismiss is the LAST in-flow child, FIXED 44x44, hidden by default.

DERIVE: Alert IconWrapper padding-top = (title line-box - 20) / 2 = (15 x 1.60 - 20) / 2 = 2px for Latin/Alert/Title. It is the Figma rendering of CSS `padding-top: calc((1lh - 20px) / 2)` and must be recomputed from the Title layer's rendered line height if the title style changes (Desktop 16 x 1.6 = 25.6 -> 2.8; Bangla 15 x 1.84 = 27.6 -> 3.8). Set it per instance on the Bangla documentation instance (3.8 -> 4). It is a raw px by necessity: no token is 2px except space/0-5, and binding a derived optical offset to a spacing token would make a spacing retune mis-centre every alert icon.

ALERT / Banner X padding binds layout/gutter-mobile (16) at the 390 master. Tablet and desktop instances override both X paddings to layout/gutter-tablet (24) / layout/gutter-desktop (32). Banner is FULL viewport width (390 master) with radius/none and strokeSides TOP+BOTTOM; Inline is 358 (390 minus gutters) with radius/md and all four edges stroked.

ALERT / Figma min height and Bangla: a 2-line Bangla title (27.6 x 2) + 4 + 5-line body (24.2 x 5) + 32 padding = 208px; the root HUGs. The surrounding checkout layout has no fixed-height rows for exactly this reason. 24.7's 'bn narrow actions' case (Actions row switching to FILL stacked buttons under 480px with two Bangla labels) cannot be an instance override - layout direction is not overridable on an instance - so it is CSS only (flex-direction: column); the lead places a DETACHED copy on the board if a picture is needed, labelled 'Alert / bn narrow actions (detached)'.

MOTION / Alert: appear = opacity 0 -> 1 over fast 120ms; dismiss = opacity 1 -> 0 over fast 120ms and the space is reclaimed INSTANTLY after the fade (no height collapse - a collapsing alert moves the form under the finger). No slide, no scale, no spring. Reduced motion: instant both ways. The spring easing cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) is forbidden here as in every component in this spec.

A11Y / Alert roles: role="status" + aria-live="polite" for Type=Info and Type=Success; role="alert" (implicitly assertive) for Type=Warning and Type=Danger. The role sits on a container that ALREADY EXISTS in the DOM so the announcement fires (3.6 rule 2). Icon aria-hidden="true". Type=Danger raised by a failed submit: tabindex="-1" and .focus() so the explanation is the first thing a keyboard/screen-reader user meets; Info/Success never steal focus. Dismiss returns focus to the element preceding the alert in the DOM, never <body>. Multi-field failure: body contains <ul> of <a href="#field-id"> links whose text is the field label; activating one calls .focus() on the input (a hash change only scrolls). The form's state survives the error.

A11Y / Alert has NO _focus and NO _scrim of its own: it is not interactive. Programmatic focus on a Danger alert shows whatever :focus-visible heuristic the browser applies - do not set outline:none on it, and do not draw a ring in Figma.

TOAST / auto-layout and alignment: root HORIZONTAL FIXED 360 x HUG, Min height 56, Max width 360, counter CENTER (a 20px icon centred against a <=2-line block reads correctly), primary MIN, padding Y space/3 X space/4, gap space/3, Clip content FALSE. Order: Icon -> TextBlock (FILL x HUG, gap space/1: Message, Detail hidden) -> Action (HasAction=True only; the layer is ABSENT on HasAction=False variants, not hidden - the axis owns its presence) -> Dismiss (44x44). Fill color/bg/surface-raised, hairline color/border/default INSIDE, radius/lg, Elevation/Light/e3 (Elevation/Dark/e3 on the dark board).

TOAST / showDetail alignment: 25.8 says that with showDetail=true and a wrapped Bangla message the root switches to counter TOP with the icon padded (1lh - 20)/2 = 2px. The Toast Icon is a direct ICON_INSTANCE with no wrapper (unlike Alert), so a per-instance top padding cannot be applied, and adding a wrapper to every variant for a case that only arises on a 2-line message with a detail - which 25.9 forbids (the detail is dropped when the message wraps) - would be structure for a state that cannot occur. DECISION: the root stays counter CENTER on every variant and instance; a 20px icon centred on a one-line message + detail block (24 + 4 + 21 = 49px) sits 2.5px below the first-line centre, imperceptible. In CSS the proper form is align-items: flex-start + padding-top: calc((1lh - 20px) / 2) under .toast--has-detail.

TOAST / Message and Detail carry NO Figma maxLines. 25.8/25.9 cap the message at 2 lines and the detail at 1, but Figma's maxLines TRUNCATES with an ellipsis, and truncation is forbidden in this document (0.7). The cap is enforced UPSTREAM by content limits (message <= 56 Bangla characters, detail <= 32) and by the rule that a wrapped 2-line message drops the detail. The Figma layers wrap freely so a reviewer sees an over-long string as a visible defect, not a hidden one.

TOAST / Action label colour: 25.5 binds the action label to color/text/link. The nested Button Variant=Ghost renders its own label token. Apply a nested FILL override of color/text/link on the Button's label text layer inside the Action instance (legal: a fill override on a nested text layer). In CSS: .toast .btn--ghost { color: var(--color-text-link) }.

TOAST / _hit44: 0.8 lists 'Toast dismiss' among _hit44 users, but 25.3 makes Dismiss an IconButton Size=Medium = 44x44 natively, so a 44x44 hit rectangle on it would be a no-op and is NOT added. The 36px Action (Button Size=Small) already contains its own _hit44 (1.8). Net: every Toast target is 44 without any layer in this manifest; the row gap space/3 (12) keeps the two 44px hit areas from overlapping.

TOAST / showDismiss is an ADDED boolean (default true; not in 25.2): 25.9 requires the dismiss to be dropped on mobile when an action is present, and that is a uniform visibility toggle across all 8 variants, so it is a legitimate property. The mobile+action documentation instance uses it.

TOAST / widths: desktop FIXED 360; mobile FILL within 16px gutters = 358 at 390px. Text width (HasAction=False) = 360 - 32 - 20 - 12 - 44 - 12 = 240; with an action (~88) and dismiss, 140; mobile with action and dismiss DROPPED = 358 - 32 - 20 - 12 - 88 - 12 = 194, which is what lets the 296px Bangla 'যোগ করা যায়নি — স্টকে মাত্র 3টি আছে' fit in 2 lines instead of 3.

BANGLA / Toast numerals: spec 25.9 writes ৩টি; binding decision 8 / CLAUDE.md rule 36 makes numerals Western in both locales, so the documentation string is 'স্টকে মাত্র 3টি আছে'. Likewise '1 item' stays '1' in the Bangla detail.

MOTION / Toast: enter mobile translateY(8px) -> 0 + opacity 0 -> 1, base 200ms decelerate cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1); enter desktop translateX(8px) -> 0 same; exit opacity 1 -> 0 + translate 4px, fast 120ms; stack reflow base 200ms standard cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1). Reduced motion: opacity only, 120ms in and out, no translate, reflow instant. THE SPRING IS NOT USED HERE: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) is forbidden in every primitive; the 'Added to cart' toast is the CONFIRMATION MESSAGE and enters on decelerate - the spring belongs exclusively to the Tier 2 add-to-cart confirmation animation on the button/cart badge, not to this toast.

MOTION / Toast timing: Success/Info 4000ms (6000ms with an action), Warning 6000ms, Danger never (manual only). Timer PAUSES on pointer hover, on focus-within and while document.hidden (visibilitychange) - a toast must not expire in a backgrounded tab; it RESUMES, never restarts. Swipe to dismiss on touch only: horizontal, threshold 25% of width or 0.5px/ms velocity, touch-action: pan-y so a vertical drag still scrolls; no swipe on pointer devices.

TOAST / position and stacking (documented by the two layoutFrames): mobile anchor bottom-centre, side offset 16, bottom offset 72 = MobileNav 56 + space/4 16, i.e. bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); 136 when the sticky AddToCartBar (64) is present, read from a CSS custom property the layout sets; stack UPWARD, newest nearest the thumb. Desktop anchor top-right at 24/24, stack downward, newest at top. Gap space/2. Max 3 visible, a fourth queues. z-index highest in the app below Modal/Drawer; above MobileNav, AddToCartBar and WhatsAppFab. Never covers the Add to cart button.

A11Y / Toast: two live regions created at first paint and never unmounted - <output aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"> receives Info/Success, <div role="alert"> receives Warning/Danger; toasts render INTO the matching region. aria-atomic so the whole toast is read, not a diff. Focus is NEVER moved to a toast. Its Action and Dismiss are in the tab order while visible and the timer pauses on focus so a keyboard user can reach them; focus returns to its origin afterwards. Esc dismisses the newest toast only when focus is inside the region. Icon aria-hidden. Cart quantity is announced by the cart badge's own live region, not by the toast, so one add never announces twice.
